_comment: The only hand-written row source for the transfer ledger: one row per atom that has moved, is moving, or has been erased. Every other atom in the census is `not-moved` by default. `scripts/ops-census.mjs` writes the complete ledger to docs/ledger/transfers.json; a guard fails if a row here names an atom the census does not have, or repeats one. The office is NOT written here — it comes from lib/ops/migration-map.ts, so a move can never disagree with the map.

rows.proof: production suites measured on the published URL: browser 28 of 28, product 21 of 21
same run, and the retired agent key is rewritten at the outer gate for old links

measured on the published site at 390px: the queue answered 21 and the sidebar door shows ٢١, pressing it lands on the conversation with the vault already open, and the stop button keeps the safety door's two-press shape

built on the new surface, not carried from the old house: it reads the people list from the customers door (the same reading the customers screen uses), stores the roll's own key on the paper, and was measured pressing it on the published site — one candidate from four digits, the name on the chip after a reload, and the paper returned to «من غير صاحب»

built on the new surface and measured on the published site at 390px: the panel answered the roll, typing ٤٤٤ in Arabic-Indic digits returned 1 candidate, pressing it opened five sections — his line from the roll, the paper's two agreed numbers with «الورقة مختومة», the browsing or its honest absence, eight colour squares off the bank, and the photo of the paper itself loaded at 900px wide — with the sheet link, a dial link and a WhatsApp link built from his digits, and 0 Latin runs anywhere in the panel. The store was left as found: the test paper went back to «من غير صاحب» (measured: 19 papers, 0 owners tonight)

measured on the published site: 200 for four real roll rows with the headline in his numerals, 404 «مفيش عميل بالاسم ده في الدفتر» for a well-formed mobile the roll does not hold, and 400 «اختار العميل من الدفتر الأول» for a malformed key and for no key at all — an empty file is never returned as if it were an answer. It reads the roll through lib/customers/read.ts, the same reader the customers screen uses, and scopes his papers by company in the statement that reads them

measured on the published site at 390px: 17 papers on the desk, each with its owner control; searching the roll in Arabic-Indic digits (٥٦٧٨) returned 1 candidate, pressing it wrote the link and the name survived a reload; a customer typing his own mobile on a paper the store could NOT read still claimed it, so the desk showed his name for it; the per-customer filter answered 2 rows with every row carrying the same key, and «شيل الاسم» put both back to «من غير صاحب» with 0 console errors. Taking the parked pixel engine out of the request cut the desk's answer from 57-63 s to 22 s on the same paper. The witnesses are now what they really are: across all 17 stored readings the offline pixel engine finished inside a request 0 times (12 honest failures between 12 and 40 s, and 4 rows that claimed 480 ms turned out to be a figure one of my own test instruments had handed the door — marked as such in the row, and the door refuses a client-supplied witness under guard). The reader proposes, the customer confirms, and the desk says which is which

the tab entry and its import are gone from app/admin/sales/page.tsx; the old deep link is answered at the outer gate (/admin/sales?tab=leads&expand=… → /admin/v2/sales?expand=…), guarded by tests/ops/legacyAddressTable.test.ts, so the consultant's Telegram messages still land on the card

the screen's door used to decide on its own who is a customer and showed 4 while the roll saw 6 (measured on the published site); it now reads lib/customers/read.ts, and measured on the built app against the live data both doors answer 6 with no phone on one side and missing on the other

live on the published URL: the window shows the sales office header, the four tier counters and five real customer rows; scripts/verify-sales-office.mjs 9 of 10, and the delete panel counted and cancelled without erasing anything

the shell that said the content would be transferred later is gone: the address now mounts the command canvas (components/admin/v2/CommandCanvas.tsx, the same module the swarm address mounts, so one counter answers both). Measured on the local house at 390px: 6 department headings in the owner's own words, 9 employee cards each named by its live role, the pulse answering ٥ عملاء and ٢ مستنيين رد and ٢١ قرار and ٠ رسائل in Arabic-Indic digits, 0 occurrences of the transfer sentence in the page text, the thumb menu opening the two sidebar doors (٢١ and the instant stop), and the first card landing on the full-screen conversation with header, composer, 75 turns, the quick-actions toggle and the decisions toggle. and measured again on the published URL at 390px after the owner's word: the same 6 department heads and 9 employee cards, the pulse answering ٥ و ٢ و ٢١, the thumb menu opening both doors, and the first card landing on the full-screen conversation with header, composer and 75 turns
